scenes.name: hook
scenes.text: Same phone, same place, but 5G downloads way faster than 4G. What actually changed?

scenes.name: lanes
scenes.text: 5G uses wider chunks of radio spectrum. A wider channel is like a wider highway. More data fits through at once.

scenes.name: freq
scenes.text: In India, 5G mostly runs around three point five gigahertz, and some at twenty six gigahertz. Higher than most 4G bands.

scenes.name: mimo
scenes.text: Towers use massive MIMO. Dozens of tiny antennas, sending separate streams to many phones at the same time.

scenes.name: beam
scenes.text: They focus the signal into a beam aimed at your phone, instead of spraying it everywhere.

scenes.name: range
scenes.text: Higher frequencies don't travel as far, and walls block them more. So 5G needs more towers.

scenes.name: lat
scenes.text: 5G also cuts delay, the time it takes to get a response, which helps gaming and video calls.

scenes.name: outro
scenes.text: Wider, higher, beams, more towers. That's the jump. Follow for more on how things really work.
